ADVERTISEMENT FOR JRF UNDER ANRF SPONSORED PROJECT
Applications are invited for the appointment of JRFs under ANRF sponsored project entitled
"Dynamic Research Ecosystem for Advanced Materials (DREAMS)" under PAIR scheme on a
purely temporary (co-terminus with the project) basis for the candidates fulfilling the following
eligibility criteria:

* Preference will be given to candidates who are planning to pursue their Ph. D. with the fellowships.
Salary & Benefits: Rs. 37,000/- + HRA (as per applicable rules) subjected to fulfillment of T&C
of funding agency and/or rules and regulations of Panjab University.
Age: Upper age limit 28 years as on the last date of receipt of application. Relaxation of upper age
limit will be applicable for reserved candidates (SC/ST, PWD etc.) as per PU/government
guidelines.
Note: The short listed candidates duly recommended by Screening/Selection Committee will be
called for an interview through email. The date and time of the interview will be intimated to the
candidates through e-mail/telephonically. Outstation candidates may be allowed to appear in the
interview through video conferencing on prior request. No Transport Allowance (TA) will be paid
for attending the interview.
How to apply:
Interested candidates may email their applications in a single pdf file with detailed biodata (including
contact number and email address) and copies of mark sheets and relevant certificates to
cnsnt@pu.ac.in by 21 November 2025 (advanced copy only). Hard copies of the application must be
submitted to the office by post/hand. Application form can be found at department website:
https://nsnt.puchd.ac.in/show-noticeboard.php?2025&nbid=47&id=84775
Note: The shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email only along with the interview date.
Sd/
Dr. Jadab Sharma
Principal Investigator of PAIR project (PU) &
Chairperson
Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology
Panjab University, Chandigarh
Page 3 of 3
GENERAL CONDITIONS
1. These positions are open only to Indian Nationals/Overseas citizens of India.
2. The posts are purely temporary (co-terminus with the project) and appointment will be in the Centre for
Nanoscience and Nanotechnology, Panjab University, Chandigarh. The successful candidate will join a large
team in close collaboration with Indian Institute of Technology, IIT-Ropar.
3. The continuation in the post will be subjected to satisfactory performance every year.
4. The engagement is initially for a temporary duration of two years (upgradation to SRF from third year based
on performance).
5. Age limit will be reckoned as on last date of receipt of application. Age relaxation is as applicable as per
PU/government guidelines.
6. The period of experience in a discipline/area of work, where prescribed, shall be counted with effect from
the date of acquiring the prescribed minimum educational qualifications for the post.
7. As the Screening/Shortlisting of applications will be done on the basis of information furnished through the
e-mail or offline application form by the applicants, it is necessary that only accurate, full and correct
information is furnished by the applicants. Furnishing of wrong/false information will be a disqualification and
Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology, Panjab University will NOT be responsible for any of the
consequences of furnishing such wrong/false information.
8. The decision of Screening/Selection Committee in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection
of applications, mode of selection, conduct of Skill Test, if any will be final and binding on the candidates and
no enquiry or correspondence will be entertained in this connection from any individual or agency on behalf of
the candidate. Candidates are binding on Panjab University rules and regulations/guidelines for any points not
traversed in general conditions.
9. Canvassing in any form and/or bringing in any influence political or otherwise will be treated as a
disqualification for the post.
10. After the appointment, the candidate is advised to work for the project for minimum one-year duration.
11. No additional grants/salary will be paid apart from the fellowship amount.
12. In case the candidate wishes to leave the job, prior information of minimum of 02 months is needed.
13. On account of official visit to other places/Laboratories/Institutes, a candidate will be entitled for
reimbursement under the project as per rules of Panjab University.
14. Eligible candidates may download the application form from Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology
website: https://nsnt.puchd.ac.in (under careers/placement/training). The application form is also given at the
end of the full advertisement). Application form duly filled in together along with recent passport size
photograph, copies of matriculation, 12th, Degree and above, Experience and certificate with reference to
nature of work carried out etc., should be sent in a sealed cover superscribing:
